title.rendered: Summer Enrollment and Middleton Summer Office Hours

content.rendered:
Middleton’s office will be closed for the summer break beginning June 24th and will re-open Monday, August 15th; 7:30-3:30. For urgent assistance, please visit our District Office, located at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd; or call 503-825-5000. Their summer office hours are Monday-Thursday, 8:00-4:00.

If you need to register a new student or a previously withdrawn student who is returning to our district please register online or contact the District Office at 503-825-5000 for assistance.
